idea: Guide boats through a tiny harbor by ringing buoys that create circular waves. Clicks select a buoy, Space rings it, and direction keys move movable buoys one cell along dock rails. A wave expands one cell per turn, pushes boats outward, opens wave gates while touching them, and cancels if it meets another wave. Levels should teach pushing one boat, moving a buoy before ringing, using waves as temporary gates, canceling waves to protect a boat, timing two boats with one wave, and final harbors where a wave must first move a boat away from its target so it can later open the return route.
title: Bell Buoys
